import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] ones = new long[17];

    static int recursiveSolve(long n, int i) {
        int baseCount = i * (int)(n / ones[i]);
        n %= ones[i];
        if (n == 0) return baseCount;
        int optionA = i + recursiveSolve(ones[i] - (int)n, i - 1);
        int optionB = recursiveSolve((int)n, i - 1);
        return baseCount + Math.min(optionA, optionB);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        ones[0] = 0;
        for (int index = 1; index < 17; ++index) {
            ones[index] = ones[index - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long val = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(recursiveSolve(val, 16));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
